Class MoleculeBuilder

java.lang.Object
io.github.wurtzitane.avogadro.api.MoleculeBuilder
public final class MoleculeBuilder extends Object
Builds a molecule definition: its shape, display name, matching items and fluids, and optional atom details.

Call build() to validate the definition. To make it available in game, register it through AvogadroApi.owner(String). 

var water = AvogadroApi.builder("example:water")
    .name("Water")
    .smiles("O");
AvogadroApi.owner("example").register(water);
